action: Experts quoted by Rossiyskaya Gazeta recommend that shoppers check the addresses of online stores themselves, including those an AI assistant recommends, and verify discounts and sales on the marketplaces' official platforms.
date_note: The page gives only its publication day.
exec: Rossiyskaya Gazeta reports that scammers are tailoring phishing sites so AI shopping assistants recommend them to buyers.
geo_basis: Country of the publisher and the companies quoted (Ozon, Yandex, RWB); no city stated
plain: Rossiyskaya Gazeta reports that scammers are tailoring fake online-shop sites so AI shopping assistants recommend them, and also using deepfake videos of famous people to announce fake sales.
summary: Rossiyskaya Gazeta reports that scammers are adapting phishing sites so that AI shopping assistants offer them as relevant results. The paper also describes deepfake videos of famous people announcing fake sales and promotions. It quotes Ozon, Yandex and RWB, and says the aim is still to steal money or personal data and to reach marketplace accounts.
title: Rossiyskaya Gazeta: scammers are getting AI shopping assistants to promote fake online stores

validation.note: Only Rossiyskaya Gazeta read; it relays comments from Ozon, Yandex and RWB, whose own pages were not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: Solar AURA not quoted by the page, removed from summary
